question.worked_solution:
We multiply each term inside the parentheses by the term outside the parentheses, simplify using the rules of exponents, and then we add the results together:

$$
\begin{aligned}-{x}^{2}(3{x}^{4}-x+2) & = \\ (-{x}^{2})(3{x}^{4})+(-{x}^{2})(-x)+(-{x}^{2})2 & = \\ ((-1)\cdot 3)({x}^{2}\cdot {x}^{4})+((-1)\cdot (-1))({x}^{2}\cdot x)+((-1)\cdot 2)({x}^{2}) & = \\ (-3){x}^{2+4}+(1){x}^{2+1}+(-2){x}^{2} & = \\ -3{x}^{6}+{x}^{3}-2{x}^{2}\end{aligned}
$$
